_what: Hand spot checks (D170, D171): for each shown or supported verdict, whether the ruling the check cited supports the move, read from that ruling's facts and holding. 'supports' = the cited ruling held origin where the same kind of part or step was done; 'partial' = right direction but a different product or an extra difference; 'does not support' = the cited ruling does not show the move works. One reader (the agent that built the set), not a customs expert.

BA-N357855-N365344.cbp_move: motor (coil wound in Thailand), metal housing and final assembly to Thailand; the planner cannot move final assembly
BA-N357855-N365344.outcome: CBP's move shown (motor-fan + housing, check 0.92); best-ranked plan is a cheaper subset (motor-fan alone, 0.92) that CBP did not rule on
BA-N357855-N365344.note: Four plans shown. The motor-fan-alone plan cites N345859, which held China because the motor, fan and heating element were Chinese: the converse, so partial support at best.

BA-N356030-N364865.note: N353886 held Thailand for a strut whose shock was made in Thailand: supports.
